label.en: ● The 4 Essential Forms of a Linear Equation — Interpretation & Instant Graphing Guide
label.ar: ● The 4 Essential Forms of a المعادلة الخطية — Interpretation & Instant Graphing Guide

body.en:
On the Digital SAT, linear equations appear in four distinct algebraic structures. Recognizing which geometric feature is exposed directly by each form saves 30–45 seconds per question:

Form Name & EquationWhat It Reveals ImmediatelySlope \(m\)\(y\)-Intercept\(x\)-Intercept (Root)How to Quickly Graph (2-Second Method)
1. Slope–\(y\)-Intercept Form
\(y = mx + c\)		Rate of change \(m\) and starting value \((0, c)\) at \(x = 0\).\(m\)\((0, c)\)\(\left(-\dfrac{c}{m},\; 0\right)\)Plot \((0, c)\) on the \(y\)-axis first; then move right \(1\) unit and up/down \(m\) units to place the second point.
2. Slope–\(x\)-Intercept (Root) Form
\(y = m(x - b)\)		Rate of change \(m\) and the horizontal root \((b, 0)\) where \(y = 0\).\(m\)\((0, -mb)\)\((b, 0)\)Plot \((b, 0)\) on the \(x\)-axis first (note the opposite sign inside \(x - b\)); then use slope \(m\) or connect to \((0, -mb)\).
3. Double-Intercept Form
\(\dfrac{x}{a} + \dfrac{y}{b} = 1\)		Both axis intercepts \((a, 0)\) and \((0, b)\) directly from the denominators.\(-\dfrac{b}{a}\)\((0, b)\)\((a, 0)\)Mark \((a, 0)\) on the \(x\)-axis and \((0, b)\) on the \(y\)-axis and draw the straight line connecting them—zero algebra needed!
4. General / Standard Form
\(ax + by + c = 0\)		Linear combination of \(x\) and \(y\); normal vector \(\langle a, b \rangle\).\(-\dfrac{a}{b}\)\(\left(0,\; -\dfrac{c}{b}\right)\)\(\left(-\dfrac{c}{a},\; 0\right)\)Use the Cover-Up Method: cover by (set \(y=0\)) to plot \(x = -c/a\); cover \(ax\) (set \(x=0\)) to plot \(y = -c/b\); connect both intercepts!

Contextual SAT Word-Problem Interpretation:

  • In \(y = mx + c\): \(c\) is the fixed initial amount / flat fee when \(x = 0\), and \(m\) is the change in \(y\) per \(1\)-unit increase in \(x\).
  • In \(y = m(x - b)\): \(b\) is the break-even / threshold input \(x\) where the output \(y\) equals zero (or the horizontal shift of \(y = mx\) by \(b\) units right).
  • In \(\dfrac{x}{a} + \dfrac{y}{b} = 1\): \(a\) is the maximum possible \(x\) when \(y = 0\), and \(b\) is the maximum possible \(y\) when \(x = 0\) (ideal for resource-allocation problems).
  • In \(ax + by + c = 0\) (or \(Ax + By = C\)): \(a\) and \(b\) are the unit rates/weights of two separate items contributing to a fixed total \(-c\).
body.ar:
On the Digital SAT, المعادلات الخطية appear in four distinct algebraic structures. Recognizing which geometric feature is exposed directly by each form saves 30–45 seconds per question:

Form Name & EquationWhat It Reveals ImmediatelySlope \(m\)\(y\)-Intercept\(x\)-المقطع (Root)How to Quickly التمثيل البياني (2-Second Method)
1. الميل–\(y\)-المقطع Form
\(y = mx + c\)		Rate of change \(m\) and starting value \((0, c)\) at \(x = 0\).\(m\)\((0, c)\)\(\left(-\dfrac{c}{m},\; 0\right)\)Plot \((0, c)\) on the \(y\)-axis first; then move right \(1\) unit and up/down \(m\) units to place the second point.
2. الميل–\(x\)-المقطع (Root) Form
\(y = m(x - b)\)		Rate of change \(m\) and the horizontal root \((b, 0)\) حيث \(y = 0\).\(m\)\((0, -mb)\)\((b, 0)\)Plot \((b, 0)\) on the \(x\)-axis first (note the opposite sign inside \(x - b\)); then use الميل \(m\) or connect to \((0, -mb)\).
3. Double-المقطع Form
\(\dfrac{x}{a} + \dfrac{y}{b} = 1\)		Both axis intercepts \((a, 0)\) and \((0, b)\) directly from the denominators.\(-\dfrac{b}{a}\)\((0, b)\)\((a, 0)\)Mark \((a, 0)\) on the \(x\)-axis and \((0, b)\) on the \(y\)-axis and draw the straight line connecting them—zero الجبر needed!
4. General / Standard Form
\(ax + by + c = 0\)		Linear combination of \(x\) and \(y\); normal المتجه \(\langle a, b \rangle\).\(-\dfrac{a}{b}\)\(\left(0,\; -\dfrac{c}{b}\right)\)\(\left(-\dfrac{c}{a},\; 0\right)\)Use the Cover-Up Method: cover by (set \(y=0\)) to plot \(x = -c/a\); cover \(ax\) (set \(x=0\)) to plot \(y = -c/b\); connect both intercepts!

Contextual SAT Word-Problem Interpretation:

  • In \(y = mx + c\): \(c\) is the fixed initial amount / flat fee عندما \(x = 0\), and \(m\) is the change in \(y\) per \(1\)-unit increase in \(x\).
  • In \(y = m(x - b)\): \(b\) is the break-even / threshold input \(x\) حيث the output \(y\) equals zero (or the horizontal shift of \(y = mx\) by \(b\) units right).
  • In \(\dfrac{x}{a} + \dfrac{y}{b} = 1\): \(a\) is the maximum possible \(x\) عندما \(y = 0\), and \(b\) is the maximum possible \(y\) عندما \(x = 0\) (ideal for resource-allocation problems).
  • In \(ax + by + c = 0\) (or \(Ax + By = C\)): \(a\) and \(b\) are the unit rates/weights of two separate items contributing to a fixed total \(-c\).

caption.en: Quick-Graphing Recipe for \(y = mx + c\): Start at the \(y\)-intercept \((0, c) = (0, 3)\), then step right \(\Delta x = 2\) and up \(\Delta y = 3\) (since \(m = 1.5 = 3/2\)) to reach \((2, 6)\). The \(x\)-intercept is \((-c/m, 0) = (-2, 0)\).
caption.ar: Quick-Graphing Recipe for \(y = mx + c\): Start at the \(y\)-المقطع \((0, c) = (0, 3)\), then step right \(\Delta x = 2\) and up \(\Delta y = 3\) (since \(m = 1.5 = 3/2\)) to reach \((2, 6)\). The \(x\)-المقطع is \((-c/m, 0) = (-2, 0)\).

caption.en: Quick-Graphing Recipe for \(y = m(x - b)\): Plot the \(x\)-intercept \((b, 0) = (2, 0)\) directly on the \(x\)-axis (where \(x - 2 = 0\)), then step right \(2\) and up \(3\) to \((4, 3)\), or plot the \(y\)-intercept \((0, -mb) = (0, -3)\).
caption.ar: Quick-Graphing Recipe for \(y = m(x - b)\): Plot the \(x\)-المقطع \((b, 0) = (2, 0)\) directly on the \(x\)-axis (حيث \(x - 2 = 0\)), then step right \(2\) and up \(3\) to \((4, 3)\), or plot the \(y\)-المقطع \((0, -mb) = (0, -3)\).

title.en: Form 3 · Double-Intercept Form: \(x / a + y / b = 1\) (Example: \(x / 4 + y / 3 = 1\))
title.ar: Form 3 · Double-المقطع Form: \(x / a + y / b = 1\) (مثال: \(x / 4 + y / 3 = 1\))

caption.en: Quick-Graphing Recipe for \(\frac{x}{a} + \frac{y}{b} = 1\): Read the \(x\)-intercept \((a, 0) = (4, 0)\) and \(y\)-intercept \((0, b) = (0, 3)\) straight from the denominators and connect them! The slope is automatically \(m = -b/a = -3/4 = -0.75\).
caption.ar: Quick-Graphing Recipe for \(\frac{x}{a} + \frac{y}{b} = 1\): Read the \(x\)-المقطع \((a, 0) = (4, 0)\) and \(y\)-المقطع \((0, b) = (0, 3)\) straight from the denominators and connect them! The الميل is automatically \(m = -b/a = -3/4 = -0.75\).

caption.en: Quick-Graphing Recipe for \(ax + by + c = 0\) (Cover-Up Method): Setting \(y = 0\) gives \(2x - 6 = 0 \implies x = -c/a = 3\), so plot \((3, 0)\). Setting \(x = 0\) gives \(3y - 6 = 0 \implies y = -c/b = 2\), so plot \((0, 2)\). The slope is \(m = -a/b = -2/3\).
caption.ar: Quick-Graphing Recipe for \(ax + by + c = 0\) (Cover-Up Method): Setting \(y = 0\) gives \(2x - 6 = 0 \implies x = -c/a = 3\), so plot \((3, 0)\). Setting \(x = 0\) gives \(3y - 6 = 0 \implies y = -c/b = 2\), so plot \((0, 2)\). The الميل is \(m = -a/b = -2/3\).

label.en: ◆ Why It Works — First-Principles Derivation (Linear Functions & Linear Inequalities)
label.ar: ◆ لماذا تعمل هذه الطريقة رياضياً — First-Principles اشتقاق (Linear الدوال & Linear المتباينات)

body.en:
Why Constant Rate of Change Defines a Linear Function: For any linear function \(f(x) = mx + b\), evaluating the change in output \(\Delta y = f(x_2) - f(x_1)\) across any interval \([x_1, x_2]\) yields:

\[ f(x_2) - f(x_1) = (mx_2 + b) - (mx_1 + b) = m(x_2 - x_1) \implies \frac{f(x_2) - f(x_1)}{x_2 - x_1} = m \]

Notice that the initial value \(b\) cancels completely, proving that equal increments \(\Delta x\) always produce equal changes \(\Delta y = m\Delta x\) anywhere along the line. Furthermore, when dividing a linear inequality ax + b < c by a negative coefficient a < 0, the order relation reverses because multiplication by \(-1\) reflects numbers across \(0\) on the real number line.
body.ar:
Why الثابت Rate of Change Defines a Linear الدالة: For any linear الدالة \(f(x) = mx + b\), evaluating the change in output \(\Delta y = f(x_2) - f(x_1)\) across any interval \([x_1, x_2]\) yields:

\[ f(x_2) - f(x_1) = (mx_2 + b) - (mx_1 + b) = m(x_2 - x_1) \implies \frac{f(x_2) - f(x_1)}{x_2 - x_1} = m \]

Notice that the initial value \(b\) cancels completely, proving that equal increments \(\Delta x\) always produce equal changes \(\Delta y = m\Delta x\) anywhere along the line. Furthermore, عندما dividing a linear المتباينة ax + b < c by a negative المعامل a < 0, the order relation reverses because multiplication by \(-1\) reflects numbers across \(0\) on the real number line.

الشرح الرياضي (الدوال الخطية والمتباينات الخطية):

If \( f(x) = 3x + 1 \), find \( f(2) - f(0) \).

Evaluate \( f(2) = 3(2) + 1 = 7 \), and \( f(0) = 3(0) + 1 = 1 \).

\[ f(2) - f(0) = 7 - 1 = 6. \]

question.en:
Level 1 · Foundations

Find the \( x \)-intercept and \( y \)-intercept of the linear equation \( 3x - 6y = 18 \).
question.ar:
Level 1 · Foundations

أوجد \( x \)-intercept and \( y \)-intercept of the linear equation \( 3x - 6y = 18 \).

solution.en:
1. \( x \)-intercept: Set \( y = 0 \): \[ 3x - 6(0) = 18 \implies 3x = 18 \implies x = 6. \text{ Intercept is } (6, 0). \]
  2. \( y \)-intercept: Set \( x = 0 \): \[ 3(0) - 6y = 18 \implies -6y = 18 \implies y = -3. \text{ Intercept is } (0, -3). \]
solution.ar:

  2. \( y \)-intercept: Set \( x = 0 \): \[ 3(0) - 6y = 18 \implies -6y = 18 \implies y = -3. \text{ Intercept is } (0, -3). \]

label.en: ⚠️ SAT Traps & Pitfalls — Rate of Change & Inequality Half-Planes
label.ar: ⚠️ SAT Traps & Pitfalls — Rate of Change & المتباينة Half-Planes

body.en:
• Rate of Change Multiplier Trap: When a question states 'the depth increases by \( 3 \) cm for every \( 10 \) minutes', the slope is \( \frac{3}{10} = 0.3 \), NOT \( 3 \). Pay close attention to the denominator units!
  • Initial Value Confusion: The \( y \)-intercept (\( x = 0 \)) represents the starting value before any change occurs. If a word problem measures time \( t \) in years since 2010, the year 2015 corresponds to \( t = 5 \), NOT \( t = 2015 \).
  • Dashed vs. Solid Boundary Lines: Strict inequalities ( < or > ) require dashed lines (boundary points excluded); inclusive inequalities (\( \le \) or \( \ge \)) use solid lines (boundary included).
  • Test-Point Method for Inequalities: Always test \( (0, 0) \) in the inequality. If \( (0,0) \) satisfies the statement, shade the region containing \( (0,0) \); if false, shade the opposite half-plane.
body.ar:
• Rate of Change Multiplier Trap: عندما a question states 'the depth increases by \( 3 \) cm for every \( 10 \) minutes', the الميل is \( \frac{3}{10} = 0.3 \), NOT \( 3 \). Pay close attention to the denominator units!
  • Initial Value Confusion: The \( y \)-المقطع (\( x = 0 \)) represents the starting value before any change occurs. If a word problem measures time \( t \) in years since 2010, the year 2015 corresponds to \( t = 5 \), NOT \( t = 2015 \).
  • Dashed vs. Solid Boundary Lines: Strict المتباينات ( < or > ) require dashed lines (boundary points excluded); inclusive المتباينات (\( \le \) or \( \ge \)) use solid lines (boundary included).
  • Test-Point Method for المتباينات: Always test \( (0, 0) \) in the المتباينة. If \( (0,0) \) satisfies the statement, shade the region containing \( (0,0) \); if false, shade the opposite half-plane.

body.en:
Problem: A plumber charges a flat consultation fee plus an hourly service rate. The total cost is modeled by \( C(h) = 45h + 80 \), where \( h \) is the hours worked. What do 45 and 80 represent?

Solution: The constant \( 80 \) is the \( y \)-intercept \( (h=0) \), representing the initial flat consultation fee (\$2). The slope \( 45 \) represents the hourly service rate (\$2 per hour).
body.ar:
Problem: A plumber charges a flat consultation fee plus an hourly service rate. The total cost is modeled by \( C(h) = 45h + 80 \), حيث \( h \) is the hours worked. What do 45 and 80 represent?

Solution: The الثابت \( 80 \) is the \( y \)-المقطع \( (h=0) \), representing the initial flat consultation fee (\$2). The الميل \( 45 \) represents the hourly service rate (\$2 per hour).

question.en:
Level 2 · Medium

An ecologist models the population \( P \) of trout in a lake as \( P(t) = 1400 - 35t \), where \( t \) is the number of years after 2015. What is the best interpretation of the number \( 35 \) in this model?
question.ar:
Level 2 · Medium

An ecologist models the population \( P \) of trout in a lake as \( P(t) = 1400 - 35t \), حيث \( t \) is the number of years after 2015. What is the best interpretation of the number \( 35 \) in this model?

solution.en: The model is in linear form \( P(t) = mt + b \), where \( b = 1400 \) is the initial population in year 2015, and \( m = -35 \) is the rate of change. The negative sign indicates a decrease. Therefore, \( 35 \) represents the estimated decrease in the trout population for each one-year increase in time.

blocks.heading: Level 3 · Advanced — Inequality Systems & Perpendicular Constraints

body.en: Solve systems of linear inequalities, identify feasible region vertices, and compute lines with perpendicular slope constraints.
body.ar: Solve systems of linear المتباينات, identify feasible region vertices, and compute lines with perpendicular الميل constraints.

body.en:
Problem: Line \( L_1 \) is given by \( 2x - 3y = 7 \). Line \( L_2 \) is perpendicular to \( L_1 \) and passes through \( (4, 1) \). What is the equation of \( L_2 \) in slope-intercept form?

Solution: The slope of \( L_1 \) is \( m_1 = \frac{2}{3} \). The perpendicular slope is the negative reciprocal: \[ m_2 = -\frac{3}{2}. \] Using point-slope form with \( (4, 1) \): \[ y - 1 = -\frac{3}{2}(x - 4) \implies y - 1 = -\frac{3}{2}x + 6 \implies y = -\frac{3}{2}x + 7. \]
body.ar:
Problem: Line \( L_1 \) is المعطيات by \( 2x - 3y = 7 \). Line \( L_2 \) is perpendicular to \( L_1 \) and passes through \( (4, 1) \). What is the المعادلة of \( L_2 \) in الميل-المقطع form?

Solution: The الميل of \( L_1 \) is \( m_1 = \frac{2}{3} \). The perpendicular الميل is the negative reciprocal: \[ m_2 = -\frac{3}{2}. \] Using point-الميل form with \( (4, 1) \): \[ y - 1 = -\frac{3}{2}(x - 4) \implies y - 1 = -\frac{3}{2}x + 6 \implies y = -\frac{3}{2}x + 7. \]

question.en:
Level 3 · Advanced

Which ordered pair \( (x, y) \) is a solution to the system of inequalities \( y > 2x - 3 \) and \( y \le -x + 4 \)?
question.ar:
حل المسألة التالية في (Linear Functions & Linear Inequalities): Level 3 · Advanced

Which ordered pair \( (x, y) \) is a solution to the system of inequalities \( y > 2x - 3 \) and \( y \le -x + 4 \)?

solution.en:
Test the candidate point \( (1, 2) \):

  1. First inequality: \( 2 > 2(1) - 3 \implies 2 > -1 \) (True).
  2. Second inequality: \( 2 \le -(1) + 4 \implies 2 \le 3 \) (True).

Since \( (1, 2) \) satisfies both inequalities simultaneously, it lies within the feasible solution region.

label.en: Level 4 (Synthesis) — Quadrant Constraint for Linear Inequality Systems
label.ar: Level 4 (Synthesis) — Quadrant Constraint for Linear المتباينة Systems

body.en:
Problem: The system of inequalities \( y \le -2x + 6 \) and \( y \ge \frac{1}{2}x - 4 \) is graphed in the \( xy \)-plane. Which quadrant contains NO solutions to the system?

Solution: Check test points or intercepts: \( y \le -2x + 6 \) has positive intercepts \( (0,6) \) and \( (3,0) \), while \( y \ge \frac{1}{2}x - 4 \) has \( y \)-intercept \( (0,-4) \). For any \( (x,y) \) in Quadrant I, II, III, or IV, test if both hold. Actually, for \( x > 4 \), \( -2x + 6 < -2 \) while \( \frac{1}{2}x - 4 > -2 \), so they cross at \( (4, -2) \) in Quadrant IV, and cover parts of QI, QII, QIII, and QIV! By contrast, if \( y > 2x + 3 \) and \( y > -x + 2 \), Quadrant IV (\( x>0, y<0 \)) contains zero solutions because \( 2x+3 > 3 > 0 \) for all \( x>0 \).

question.en:
Level 4 · Synthesis

Line \( \ell \) passes through \( (2, -1) \) and is perpendicular to the line \( 3x + 6y = 18 \). If line \( \ell \) also passes through \( (k, 9) \), what is the value of \( k \)?
question.ar:
Level 4 · Synthesis

Line \( \ell \) يمر بالنقطة \( (2, -1) \) and is عمودي على the line \( 3x + 6y = 18 \). إذا كان line \( \ell \) also يمر بالنقطة \( (k, 9) \), ما قيمة \( k \)?

solution.en:
Rewrite \( 3x + 6y = 18 \) in slope-intercept form: \( 6y = -3x + 18 \implies y = -\frac{1}{2}x + 3 \), so its slope is \( -\frac{1}{2} \).

The perpendicular line \( \ell \) has slope \( m_\ell = 2 \). Using \( (2, -1) \) and \( (k, 9) \):

\[ \frac{9 - (-1)}{k - 2} = 2 \implies \frac{10}{k - 2} = 2 \implies k - 2 = 5 \implies k = 7. \]
solution.ar:

label.en: ● Master Atlas of the 9 Main Parent Functions & Universal Transformation Law
label.ar: ● الأطلس الشامل للدوال الأم التسع وقانون التحويلات الهندسية العام

body.en:
Every algebraic and elementary transcendental model is built by transforming one of the nine core parent functions via \(g(x) = a\,f(x - h) + k\), where \(|a|\) scales vertically (reflecting across the \(x\)-axis if \(a < 0\)), \(h\) shifts horizontally, and \(k\) shifts vertically:

FamilyTransformed Form \(g(x)\)DomainRange (\(a > 0\))Key Geometric Feature
Constant\(f(x) = c\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\(\{c\}\)Horizontal line, slope \(0\)
Linear\(a(x - h) + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)Constant slope \(m = a\), pivot \((h, k)\)
Quadratic\(a(x - h)^2 + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\([k, \infty)\)Parabola vertex \((h, k)\), axis \(x = h\)
Cubic\(a(x - h)^3 + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)Inflection center \((h, k)\), S-curve
Absolute Value\(a|x - h| + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\([k, \infty)\)V-corner vertex \((h, k)\), slopes \(\pm a\)
Radical\(a\sqrt{x - h} + k\)\([h, \infty)\)\([k, \infty)\)Endpoint \((h, k)\), half-parabola
Rational\(\dfrac{a}{x - h} + k\)\(x \neq h\)\(y \neq k\)Vertical asymptote \(x = h\), horizontal \(y = k\)
Exponential\(a \cdot 2^{x - h} + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\((k, \infty)\)Horizontal asymptote \(y = k\), anchor \((h, a+k)\)
Logarithmic\(a\ln(x - h) + k\)\((h, \infty)\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)Vertical asymptote \(x = h\), anchor \((h+1, k)\)
body.ar:
تُبنى النماذج الجبرية والمتسامية الأساسية من خلال تطبيق التحويل القياسي \(g(x) = a\,f(x - h) + k\) على إحدى الدوال الأم التسع، حيث يتحكم \(|a|\) في التمدد الرأسي (مع انعكاس حول محور السينات إذا كان \(a < 0\))، ويمثل \(h\) الإزاحة الأفقية، و\(k\) الإزاحة الرأسية:

عائلة الدالةالصورة المحوّلة \(g(x)\)المجالالمدى (\(a > 0\))السمة الهندسية المميزة
الثابتة\(f(x) = c\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\(\{c\}\)مستقيم أفقي ميله \(0\)
الخطية\(a(x - h) + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)ميل ثابت \(m = a\) ونقطة ارتكاز \((h, k)\)
التربيعية\(a(x - h)^2 + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\([k, \infty)\)قطع مكافئ رأسه \((h, k)\) ومحوره \(x = h\)
التكعيبية\(a(x - h)^3 + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)نقطة انعطاف مركزية \((h, k)\)
القيمة المطلقة\(a|x - h| + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\([k, \infty)\)رأس زاوي على شكل V عند \((h, k)\) بميلين \(\pm a\)
الجذرية\(a\sqrt{x - h} + k\)\([h, \infty)\)\([k, \infty)\)نقطة بداية \((h, k)\) ومجال مقيّد \(x \ge h\)
النسبية (المقلوب)\(\dfrac{a}{x - h} + k\)\(x \neq h\)\(y \neq k\)تقارب رأسي \(x = h\) وتقارب أفقي \(y = k\)
الأسية\(a \cdot 2^{x - h} + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\((k, \infty)\)تقارب أفقي \(y = k\) ونقطة ارتكاز \((h, a+k)\)
اللوغاريتمية\(a\ln(x - h) + k\)\((h, \infty)\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)تقارب رأسي \(x = h\) ونقطة ارتكاز \((h+1, k)\)
